ζάγκλον.definition: reaping-hook, sickle, Sicilian for Th.6.4, cf. Call.Aet.Oxy.2080.73

ζάγρα.definition: and Dim. a term of abuse, Timostr.4

ζάδηλος.definition: for of a sail with holes in it, Alc.18.7

ζαλμός.definition: Thracian word for a skin, Porph.VP14

ζάπυρος.definition: very fiery, A.Pr.1084 ; Orac. ap. Porph. ap. Eus.PE6.3

ζαφλεγής.definition: Ep. Adj. full of fire, of men at their; shining, bright, Orac. ap. Eus.PE3.15; Nonn.D.2.26

ζαχρεῖος.definition: very needy: c. gen., one who wants to know the way, asks eagerly after it, Theoc.25.6

ζαχρηής.definition: used only in pl., attacking violently, furious, raging, Il.5.525 ; of warriors, . . 12.347, cf. 13.684; cf. ; cf. .)

ζάψ.definition: surf, Cratin.Jun.13, cf. Euph.3, Simm.11; . . Dionys.Iamb. ap. Clem.Al.Strom.5.8.47

ζέα.definition: = D.H.2.25, Dsc.2.89 : nom; the roof of a horse's mouth, Hippiatr.1,8. , Lith. javaĩ 'corn'.)

ζειά.definition: usu. in pl. , one-seeded; rice-wheat, in sg., Thphr.HP8.9.2, al. ; Triticum dicoccum, Dsc. l.c. , Gal. l.c

ζείδωρος.definition: zea-giving , as; some authors derived it from = , life-giving, Emp.151; Nonn.D.12.23, cf. 22.276

ζέμα.definition: fermentation, Heras; boiling, bringing it to the boil, Heras ap.Gal.13.548; keep it on the boil, Orib.Fr.113; a boiled fowl, Alex.Trall.Febr.1

ζεῦξις.definition: yoking or manner of yoking; bridging, Id.4.88; Id.7.35

ζῆνος.definition: perh. = made of spelt , UPZ94.1, al

ζιζουλά.definition: jujube, Alex.Trall.6.5; cf. sq. and Ital. giuggiola, zizzola

ζυγία.definition: maple, Acer campestre, Thphr.HP3.3.1, 5.3.3, Dicaearch.2.2, Plin.HN16.67

ζύγρα.definition: dialectic form for , marsh- land, Eust.295.28

ζῴαρχος.definition: commander of one elephant, Ascl.Tact.9.1, Ael.Tact.23.1

ζῶγρος.definition: late form for cage, Phlp.in de

ζωθάλμιος.definition: giving the bloom and freshness of life, Pi.O.7.11

ζωθαλπής.definition: warming or cheering life, Nonn.D.1.454:— fem. ib.16.397

ζωθήκη.definition: small room wherein to rest by day, opp; niche in a wall, prob. in Apollod.Poliorc.145.1 ; used as a chapel, Supp.Epigr.2.849 ; Lat.zotheca, Dessau ILS5449, al

ζῶμα.definition: loin-cloth, drawers, worn; band used in surgery, Hp.Art.14

ζωμός.definition: Dor. , soup or sauce to eat with; Com. name for fat, greasy fellow, Anaxandr.34.5, cf. Aristopho4.3

ζώπισσα.definition: pitch and wax from old ships, or pine- resin, Dsc.1.72

ζωρύα.definition: perh.= pipe for running water, IG4.823.46 ; cf

ζώσιμος.definition: viable, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.47; likely to; pertaining to this life, prob. in Phld. Herc.1251.9

ζωστήρ.definition: in Il. always a warrior's; later, = a woman's girdle, Paus.1.31.1: metaph., of the encircling sea, . . , . . AP9.421 ; Secund.Sent.2

ζαλάω.definition: in Ep. part. . . driving hail, Nic.Th.252

ζαλλεύω.definition: Aeol. imper. 3pl. dub. sens. in Alc. Oxy. 1789 Fr. 1 i marg

ζαμενέω.definition: to put forth all one's fury, Hes.Th.928

ζεύγλη.definition: loop attached to the yoke , through; = I.1, BGU1507 .—Not found in good Att. Prose

ζεύγνυμι.definition: bind fast, X.An.3.5.10: —Pass., . . having them fastened . . , E.El.317

ζεφύριος.definition: sts. also , of the; wind-egg, also Arist.HA560a6, GA749b1

ζέω.definition: contr. 3sg. even in Il.21.362; later Ep; ferment, Hp.VM11; Dsc.5.8

ζηλέω.definition: = etym. of Eust.70.30:—in Dor. form to be zealous for, SIG734.7

ζήλωμα.definition: that which is emulated: object of; in pl. also, emulous efforts, rivalries, Aeschin.1.191, AP7.219 , cf. D.19.260

ζήλωσις.definition: emulation, imitation; zealous pursuit, Ph.1.362; custom, fashion, ib.468

ζηλωτής.definition: emulator, zealous admirer or follower; jealous, LXXEx.20.5

ζητέω.definition: Dor. part. Theoc.1.85: impf; inquire for, IG12.91.11; X.An.2.3.2: with relat. clause, Id.Cyr.8.5.13

ζυγάρχης.definition: leader of a line of horsemen, Ascl.Tact.7.9, Ael.Tact.19.8:—hence Ascl. l.c

ζυγέω.definition: march in line, opp; form a line, of contingents, Plb.3.113.8

ζυγόω.definition: yoke, join together, Sor.1.84; close, Paul.Aeg.6.67 ; shut off, Hp.Cord.12

ζυμίωσις.definition: = subject of lost work by Zos.Alch.p.216B

ζυμόω.definition: cause to effervesce, Gal.10.964, Aët.1 Praef.:—Pass., Alex.124.8

ζῶ.definition: prop. of animal life, live, Hom. , etc.; also of plants, Arist.EN1097b33; vilest of living men, Od.10.72; Il.24.558; 1.88, cf. Od.16.439; A.Ag.677; Od.24.263; D.18.72; Pl.R.369d; Id.Lg.809d; Id.Phdr.276a; living at ea…

ζωγρέω.definition: take, save alive, take captive; restore to life and strength, revive, Il.5.698 ; preserve alive, Epigr.Gr.841.7

ζώμευμα.definition: soup, put by way of joke for , Ar.Eq.279

ζώνη.definition: prop. the lower girdle worn by women just above the hips, Od.5.231, 10.544, cf. Il.14.181, Hdt.1.51, etc.—Phrases

ζώννυμι.definition: Med., gird oneself, esp. of athletes. IG7.52.6 ; Il.23.685, cf. 710; Od.24.89; 18.67, cf. Parth.10.2

ζῳοτροφέω.definition: breed or have parasitic animals; keep animals, Id.2.233

ζωοφορέω.definition: of animals, bring forth alive, Arist.HA638a31; of plants, bear fruit, Gp.5.13.1

ζωοφυτέω.definition: put forth live shoots, flourish; produce alive or endow with life, Ph.2.372: with v.l. ib.294

ζῳόω.definition: fashion into an animal, pf. inf. Pass. Alex.Aphr.in Top.137.26

ζώπυρον.definition: spark or hot coal, used to kindle a; Act., pair of bellows, Ephor.42J

ζωφορία.definition: Ion. the sun's progress through the zodiac, Man.4.510

ζώφυτος.definition: giving life to plants; Pass., spring from the earth, plants, Dius ap. Stob.4.21.16

ζά.definition: Aeol. for rarely as Prep; as Prefix , very, in Ep. Adjs., etc.; cf

ζῳηδόν.definition: Adv., in the manner of beasts, Plb.6.5.9

ζῳδιοκράτωρ.definition: divinity presiding over the zodiac, Dam.Pr.131,351

ζυγοφόρος.definition: bearing the yoke, E.HF121 ; Plu.2.524a: elsewh. in poet. form

ζοφόω.definition: darken, Hld.2.15:—Pass., to be or become dark, AP6.92 ; Ps.-Luc.Philopatr.4

ζάλευκος.definition: very white, f.l. in Orac. ap. Zos.2.6

ζηλομανής.definition: mad with jealousy, ib.5.217 , cf. Nonn.D.41.211

ζίζυφον.definition: a tree, the fruit of which is the jujube, Zizyphus vulgaris, Gp.10.3.4; ziziphus, Colum.9.4.3: gen. pl. zizuforum, Edict. Diocl.6.56

ζηλωτέος.definition: one must emulate or copy, Plb.4.27.8, Plu.2.12a; Id.Fr.inc.2

ζωνιοπλόκος.definition: plaiting or embroidering girdles, Thom.Mag.p.168 R

ζευγοποιία.definition: the making of mouthpieces for double flutes, Thphr.HP4.11.6

ζύγωσις.definition: a balancing, of heavy oars, Callix.1

ζημίωμα.definition: loss, opp. BGU419.13 ; injury, damage, D.C.52.33

ζυγαρχία.definition: detachment of two chariots, ib.8, Ael.Tact.22.2

ζεόπυρον.definition: a variety of Triticum monococcum, Gal.6.515

ζωόμορφος.definition: in the shape of an animal, Plu.Num.8

ζεῦγλα.definition: poet. for sq., E.Fr.285.10, cf. Lyr.Alex.Adesp.11.8, AP9.19 , Choerob.in Theod.1.304

ζήτησις.definition: seeking, search for; searching, examining, searched the ships, Hdt.6.118, cf. Lys.12.30, Aeschin.1.43

ζῳοπλαστέω.definition: mould to the life, make into statues; work into life-shape, Ph.1.13

ζῷον.definition: living being, animal, Hdt.5.10; in art, figure, image, not necessarily of animals , Hdt.3.88: mostly in pl., Id.1.203, cf. 2.4,124,148, Pl.R.515a, etc.; to have pictures of the bridging of the Bosporus painted, Hdt.4.…

ζωοφόρος.definition: life-giving, IG3.171; AP9.765; bearing animals: and so

ζητήσιμος.definition: to be searched, places to be beaten for game, X.Cyn.6.6

ζωμοποιέω.definition: make into soup or sauce, Xenocr.54

ζῳογενής.definition: of animate kind, mortal, opp. Pl.Plt.309c

ζῳοπλάστης.definition: the Creator, ib.184; a moulder of creatures, sculptor, etc., Id.2.211

ζεύκτειρα.definition: fem. from sq., of Aphrodite, Orph.H.55.3

ζοφοειδής.definition: dark-coloured, Hp.Mul.1.11; of the colour of an elephant, Aret.SD2.13

ζωνιαῖος.definition: as thick as a girdle, Ath.Mech.38.3

ζῳοτύπος.definition: modelling animals from life, Nonn.D.5.527, Man.4.343: generally, modelling to the life, of a sculptor, AP15.1

ζωνοειδής.definition: like a belt or girdle, Apollon.Lex. s.v. Eust.1068.24. Adv. in belts, Olymp.in Mete.191.21

ζῳοφαγία.definition: a living on animal food, ib.628b13, Porph.Abst.2.27, 4.21

ζυγοστατέω.definition: weigh by the balance, weigh; act as libripens, MitteisChr.316ii4

ζωνοφόρος.definition: wearing a belt, PRain.in Wiener Denkschr.42.4
